$comment: Sub-agent role registry. Read by the Antigravity leads (Claude, Gemini) now, and by the Mika OS orchestrator once Phase D dispatch is wired up. Human version: obsidian/Agents/Sub-Agent Roles.md. A task file's `role:` field names one of these roles. Updated 2026-10-24 (v2: new-role rule); 2026-10-27 (v3: explorer, scribe, privacy-guard, applications, git-keeper; Claude agent files in .claude/agents/).
run_mode_note: Mika 2026-10-24: run sub-agents in Antigravity (Claude + Gemini). Do not start the local/offline PM2 agents for now.

parallel.same_role_instances: One instance per independent target. When a request covers several apps or websites (or several variants of one), split it into one task per target and launch one sub-agent of the same role per task, in parallel, up to max_working_tasks.
parallel.no_overlap_rule: Two instances may run together only if their `touches` (or working-copy folders) do not overlap. If they overlap, the later task depends_on the earlier one.
parallel.isolation: New files/folders: write directly. Existing files: work on a copy in <workspace>/_worktrees/T-xxxx/ and copy back after Mika approves (most portfolio files are not tracked in git).
parallel.max_working_tasks_note: Raise only when Mika agrees (every result needs his review).

common_limits: Change only files in the task's touches (or its working copy)
Never publish, push, commit, send, delete, or contact anyone
Facts only from Mika's notes and files; never invent numbers, clients or dates
No phone numbers, emails or references' contacts on the portfolio
Finish with Tasks/Results/T-xxxx.md, set status: review, stop

web-builder.does: Builds or edits websites and pages: concept sites, portfolio pages, switchers, content updates.
web-builder.test: Headless Chrome at 1440x900 and 390x844: no console errors, scrollWidth - innerWidth == 0, look at every screenshot, reduced motion works.

motion-3d-builder.does: Three.js scenes, hero animations, logo intros, scroll-driven motion.
motion-3d-builder.test: web-builder tests plus timed frames (freeze hooks like ?heroT= / ?introT=), real-GPU fps (--use-angle=d3d11), pause off-screen, reduced-motion still frame, no-WebGL fallback.

app-builder.does: Desktop/mobile apps: Mika OS Electron app, other Electron or React Native apps.
app-builder.test: Build/run the app, drive it (e.g. puppeteer over the Electron debug port), screenshot, no console errors; never expose API keys in the frontend.

engine-developer.does: Backend/engine code with tests, e.g. a Python engine, agent shared libraries.
engine-developer.test: Run the project's test suite and harness; report exact commands and results.

case-study-writer.does: Portfolio write-ups and case studies from real code and notes; every claim cites a file.
case-study-writer.test: Every claim has a file citation; privacy grep (emails, phones) is clean.

design-librarian.does: Documents designs in the Design Library: site notes, tokens, patterns, style notes, screenshots.
design-librarian.test: All template headings filled; values measured not guessed (est. marked); wiki-link check passes; studied designs marked study, own work marked own-work.

researcher.does: Web or document research that feeds a task (sources, competitors, references). Read-only.
researcher.test: Every fact has a source URL and date.

reviewer.does: Independent check of another sub-agent's result against its done_test (scope, screenshots, facts). Used by the lead; never edits the work.
reviewer.model_hint: the other model than the one that built it
reviewer.test: Re-run the key checks; report pass/fail per done_test part.

github-organizer.does: Audits and organises Mika's GitHub (account mikachamp) via the gh CLI: repo inventory, descriptions, topics, READMEs, licences, pinned repos, stale or duplicate repos, secrets and privacy risks in public repos, which local projects have no repo or backup. Produces a report plus a numbered change list.
github-organizer.test: Every finding cites the repo and file or API field; read-only gh commands only (gh repo list/view, gh api GET).
github-organizer.limits_extra: READ-ONLY on GitHub. Never create, rename, archive, delete, transfer, push, change visibility, edit descriptions/topics or open issues/PRs without Mika approving that exact numbered change. Never print tokens. Treat public repos as a privacy check (no phone numbers, emails, client data, .env).

explorer.does: Fast read-only search: finds files, reads code or notes and returns a short summary with paths so the lead saves context.
explorer.test: Answer cites paths; says clearly what was not found; wrote nothing.
explorer.approved_by: Mika ('create more agents you think are necessary and the rules for them')

scribe.does: Records finished work in the vault: Tasks/Results/T-xxxx.md, build-log rows, project notes, status to review, moves the lock to Tasks/locks/released/.
scribe.test: Result note present with files, checks and open issues; status is review (never done); only files under obsidian/ changed.
scribe.approved_by: Mika ('create more agents you think are necessary and the rules for them')

privacy-guard.does: Read-only check of anything that can be seen by others (portfolio, client concepts, artifacts, case studies, screenshots) for personal data, client confidentiality, consent and missing concept banners.
privacy-guard.test: Every finding cites file and line or image with a suggested fix; images were actually looked at; changed nothing.
privacy-guard.approved_by: Mika ('create more agents you think are necessary and the rules for them')

applications.does: Drafts job applications: fit score for a listing, tailored CV summary and bullets, short cover letter, tracker row. Facts only from the user's CV note; drafts only, never submits.
applications.test: Every claim traces to the CV; listing link and fit reasons recorded; drafts saved under obsidian/Career/Applications/; nothing sent or submitted.
applications.approved_by: Mika ('create more agents you think are necessary and the rules for them')

git-keeper.does: Backup planner for local projects: secret and client-data scan, .gitignore check, proposed commit groups and messages, and the exact commands (incl. gh repo create --private) for Mika to run. Never runs git add/commit/push itself.
git-keeper.test: Scan results listed per repo; commands are copy-paste ready; working tree unchanged (git status identical before and after).
git-keeper.approved_by: Mika ('create more agents you think are necessary and the rules for them')

not_for_subagents.mika: Tasks with assignee: mika (decisions, approvals, contacting people, submitting applications, deleting files). Never launch a sub-agent for these.

new_roles.rule: The orchestrator/lead may add more instances of any active role freely (within max_working_tasks). It may also DRAFT a new role when work fits none of the existing roles.
new_roles.how: Add the role under roles with status: proposed and all fields (does, champ_os_owner, model_hint, extra_reading, test, parallel_ok), plus proposed_by and proposed_on. Note it in the task result and tell Mika.
new_roles.proposed_role_limits: A proposed role may be used straight away only for read-only or notes-only work (research, drafts, design notes). It must not build, edit code or files outside a notes path until Mika approves it once; then set status: active and approved_on.
new_roles.cannot_change: No role, new or old, can change the common_limits (never publish, push, commit, send, delete, or contact anyone; facts only from Mika's notes; privacy) or raise max_working_tasks. Only Mika changes those.
